name: vibesdk-auth-api-lambda
description: API Gateway HTTP API (v2) Lambda handler for the auth routes (worker/api/routes/authRoutes.ts, worker/api/controllers/auth/controller.ts), wired to vibesdk-auth-orchestration. scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../auth-api-lambda.zip handler.js
